title: Posted Schedule: The Release Rate Kept on Bushels a Member Is Released From
content:
The release rate is the per-bushel charge the cooperative keeps on bushels it releases under Grain Marketing Contracts, and which rate applies turns on what the programme sold the member.

**1.** Where the contract's programme carries a price floor premium, the release is struck at that floor premium per bushel, since the cooperative bought the floor on bushels that will now never be delivered.

**2.** Where the programme carries no floor premium and tickets stand against the contract, whatever the disposition, the release is struck at the delivered release rate of 0.16 per bushel.

**3.** Where neither of those holds, the release is struck at the default penalty per bushel the programme carries, which is what the same bushels would carry if the member simply let the window close.

## The floor premium each programme carries

| Programme | Price floor premium (USD per bushel) |
|---|---|
| Spot Cash Delivery Ticket | 0.00 |
| Forward Cash Sale Contract | 0.00 |
| Basis Fixed Contract | 0.00 |
| Hedge-to-Arrive Contract | 0.00 |
| Delayed Price Agreement | 0.00 |
| Minimum Price Contract | 0.24 |
| Managed Accumulator Program | 0.00 |

The first clause is read before the others, so a contract on the one programme carrying a floor premium is struck at 0.24 per bushel whether or not tickets stand against it. On every other programme the second clause is reached where at least one ticket stands against the contract, whatever the disposition — a ticket the member directed to the contract at the scale and a load the member ran straight through to the buyer both count — and the third where none does.

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

On 10,000 undelivered bushels of a Minimum Price Contract, the release is struck at 0.24, being 2,400.00 before the multiplier and the factor. The same bushels on a programme carrying no floor premium, with three tickets standing, are struck at 0.16, being 1,600.00. With no ticket standing at all, they are struck at the default penalty that programme carries.
